families.name: MV Funa
families.notes: Based on the handwriting in Viyafaari Miadhu (1968). Its OpenType features are tested in Microsoft Word; some, like the raised Thaana full stop, don't work in Adobe InDesign or other apps.
families.description:
Reworked by Hassan in 2025, 2026. Though the font was not publicly released except in 2026, some have used the font to write large books. The reason why people find this font elegant is rather mysterious but presumably it is because the defining features are emphasized... the real reason belongs to the black art of typography.

The font is suitable for microtext.

Four weights of this font were released in 2026.

Originally, Funa is a Thaana text face that was developed in 1996 for Accent Express and FaseyhaThaana. All fonts have Swiss/Helvetica-like Latin glyphs allowing a single font to set text in both most Western European languages and Thaana. The original calligraphy is from the annual issue of Viyafaari Miadhu, 1968, probably written by Dhaarul Iqaamaa Sodiq.
